test_case.test_name: AGFHC single_pass full-evidence run with disabled internal timeout and independent watchdog
test_case.purpose: Execute every test in the exact AGFHC single_pass profile once, write all evidence to the approved output tree, prove the documented success result and prevent an unbounded hang through independent wall-time and hardware-health controls.
required_package: AMD-authorized signed AGFHC build, checksum/license/user guide and matching ROCm/driver/firmware/definitions versions
Pinned `single_pass` recipe/profile listings and per-GPU/subtest expectations for the exact build
Approved `/opt/amd/agfhc/logs` ownership, free capacity, retention, collision policy and immutable run-directory name
Project-approved maximum wall time and independent watchdog that does not alter the recipe's one-pass coverage
Stable GPU identity map, dedicated load window, cooling/power/RAS/thermal thresholds, OOB access and recovery
test_case.test_command: After validating artifacts, recipe/profile info, output capacity and GPU health, create an immutable run-specific directory under the approved output tree. Under high-load approval execute the exact source profile once: `/opt/amd/agfhc/agfhc -r single_pass -o <approved_run_dir> -p single_pass --disable-timeout`. Capture full stdout/stderr and real process status while a separate controller enforces only the signed maximum wall time and hardware-health abort rules. Preserve terminal summary, results.json and the entire log tree, then compare per-GPU RAS/dmesg/thermal/power and system health.
test_case.expected_result: The pinned single_pass recipe runs every expected test once on every mapped GPU, produces a complete non-overwritten result tree, terminates within the approved external bound without watchdog abort, returns actual process status 0 and `AGFHC_SUCCESS [0]`, and records no required subtest failure, skip, GPU loss, RAS/dmesg, thermal, power or system fault.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact artifact/profile/path evidence, full untruncated stdout/stderr, actual process exit status 0, `AGFHC_SUCCESS [0]`, complete results.json/log tree, every expected GPU/subtest once and clean synchronized health evidence. A generic AGFHC summary, missing artifacts, shell-pipeline code or watchdog termination cannot pass.
safety_gate: Verify the authorized AGFHC/ROCm/definitions compatibility and exact single_pass contents before load
Preflight output ownership/capacity and use a new run directory; never overwrite prior evidence
Approve `--disable-timeout` and the independent maximum wall-time/health watchdog as separate gates
Run only with independent management and cooling/power headroom; preserve default RAS/dmesg/system monitoring
Abort on GPU loss/reset, RAS/dmesg failure, thermal/power threshold, hang, output exhaustion or access loss; never auto-retry
expected_evidence: AGFHC/ROCm/driver/firmware/definitions versions/checksums and exact single_pass recipe/profile listing
Output-tree ownership/capacity preflight and immutable run-directory manifest
Exact command/environment, full stdout/stderr, process status, summary, duration, results.json and complete log tree
Expected-versus-observed per-GPU/subtest once-only coverage with failure/skip analysis
Independent watchdog trace and synchronized RAS/dmesg/thermal/power/system telemetry
test_case.recovery: On watchdog or health abort, preserve the process state, full partial output tree and telemetry before terminating according to the AMD guide; verify every GPU and management path, restore only approved temporary profile/output settings and escalate. Do not rerun automatically or delete partial logs.
